rationale: At turn 11 with 4 h remaining, I'm in stationary-phase growth. I maximize uptake of abundant fermentable substrates (acetate, formate, propionate) while drawing nitrogen from available amino acids (glutamate, aspartate, leucine, threonine). This supports moderate growth (0.16 /h) while maintaining carbon and nitrogen balance. Fermentation products (acetate, propionate, formate, succinate, CO₂) are released as typical Prevotella mixed-acid fermentation end products. The low growth rate reflects the high cell density and limited remaining time.
